change_summary: PLOS ONE retracted this paper. The editors say it was one of a series of submissions with concerns about peer review integrity and possible manipulation of the publication process. They say these concerns call the validity and provenance of the reported results into question. The notice says the author did not respond or could not be reached.
evaluation: Your draft cites the retracted paper as [14] in two places. In Section 3 it is called "the main evidence for our choice" of an LSTM, and in Section 4 its settings are the untuned starting configuration. The retraction covers the whole paper, and the editors say it calls the validity and provenance of the reported results into question. Both uses are touched, and the impact is high because the model choice and the starting settings both rest on this paper.
recommendation: PLOS ONE retracted Dutta [14] because of concerns about peer review integrity and possible manipulation of the publication process, and the editors say the validity and provenance of its results are in question. Your draft uses it as the main evidence for the LSTM choice and as the source of your starting settings, so raise it with co-authors or your supervisor, and replace the evidence and justify the settings independently.
